schema.pixel_value_definition: ALUM v8 land-use code stored in each raster cell. The category table links each Value to a SIMPN simplified land-use group.

raster_attribute_table_fields.name: Value
raster_attribute_table_fields.definition: Pixel value / ALUM v8 land-use code.

raster_attribute_table_fields.name: Count
raster_attribute_table_fields.definition: Number of raster cells represented by the category-table row.

raster_attribute_table_fields.name: SIMPN
raster_attribute_table_fields.definition: Simplified land-use class number used by this workflow for reclassification.

raster_attribute_table_fields.name: SIMP
raster_attribute_table_fields.definition: Name of the simplified land-use class.

raster_attribute_table_fields.name: AGIND
raster_attribute_table_fields.definition: Source agriculture indicator field; retain the product's coding.

schema.interpretation_note: The configured output label 'urban' combines source class 14 (intensive horticulture and animal production) with urban, other intensive, and mining/waste classes. This documents the current mapping; it does not redefine the source categories.
schema.unmapped_category_rule: Known SIMPN categories without a numeric output mapping become NA; source SIMPN 0 is nodata and is not listed as a land-use class.
